site.title: Testigo: report harms from artificial intelligence and neurotechnology
banner: Prototype with synthetic data. Not an official reporting channel. Do not submit real information.
exit.help: Opens another page and leaves this site out of your history (if your browser allows it). With the keyboard: press Esc twice.
intro.heading: Tell us what happened
intro.lead: If an artificial intelligence or neurotechnology system harmed you or someone you know, you can tell us here. You don't need an account or to give your name.
intro.what.heading: What happens to your report
intro.what.1: It is read by people on the analysis team of the organization that receives the reports. No one else.
intro.what.2: It is stored encrypted. Your contact details, if you choose to give them, are stored separately, with a different key.
intro.what.3: An artificial intelligence program does a first reading to suggest what kind of case it is and whether anyone is at risk. It runs on the organization's own servers ({ai}). A person reviews and decides everything.
intro.what.4: At the end you get a case code and a secret phrase. Keep them: without them we can't find your report, because we don't know who you are.
intro.risks.heading: Before you write
intro.risks.1: If you include names, RUT numbers, phone numbers or addresses, someone could recognize you or other people. We'll let you know if the text seems to contain details like these; you decide what to keep.
intro.risks.2: How long reports are kept and how to withdraw one is still to be agreed with the organization that receives them. In this prototype, demonstration reports are deleted.
intro.risks.3: If someone is in danger right now, call the emergency numbers first.
intro.ai.local: with a model that runs on its own servers
intro.ai.mock: in this demonstration, a simulated program
intro.ai.cloud: with an outside service that receives only the text with personal details removed
emergency.heading: If someone is in danger right now
form.heading: Your report
form.region.note: Only if it happened in Chile.
form.contact.heading: Would you like to be contacted?
form.contact.help: This is optional. Without your permission we don't keep any contact details.
form.contact.value: Your email, phone number or Signal username
form.passphrase.heading: Your secret phrase
form.passphrase.help: With your case code and this phrase you can come back to your report later. If you leave it blank, we'll give you one made of six words. At least {min} characters.
form.passphrase.label: Secret phrase (optional)
form.consents.heading: Your permissions
form.errors: Please check what is marked below.
pii.heading: Your text seems to contain details that could identify someone
pii.choice: You can change the text before sending it, or send it as it is. Nothing is removed without telling you: the analysis team works with a copy that replaces these details, but the original text is stored encrypted.
pii.edit: Check the text below and send it again.
unavailable: We couldn't receive the report right now. What you wrote is not lost: it is still in the form. Please try again in a few minutes.
unavailable.form: The form isn't available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
toomany: Too many reports were sent from this connection in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
done.heading: We received your report
done.passphrase.chosen: The phrase you chose (we don't show it).
done.save: Write down the code and the phrase somewhere safe, or print this page. If you lose them we can't recover them, because we don't know who you are. This page isn't saved in your browser.
done.next.heading: What happens now
done.next.1: A person on the analysis team will read your report.
done.next.2: Later you'll be able to see the status of your case with your code and your phrase. This isn't available yet in the prototype.
done.support.heading: Support
done.danger: Your report mentions a possible risk to someone's life or safety. If so, call now:
done.print: To print, use your browser's Print option.
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.lead: We couldn't show this page. What you wrote was not saved. Go back to the start and try again.
notfound.heading: We couldn't find this page
notfound.lead: The address may be mistyped. From the start page you can reach the form.
expired.lead: The form expired or couldn't be verified. Open it again and try again.
footer: Testigo is an open-source prototype. It is not an official reporting channel.
